name: Northcourt Solstice Outdoor Ball
description: The Northcourt Solstice Outdoor Ball is a 40-hole, rotationally molded outdoor ball tuned for cold-weather play. Its low-temperature polymer resists cracking below 45 degrees Fahrenheit, which is when most outdoor balls turn brittle.
care_instructions: Store indoors between sessions. Warm the ball in a pocket before play on cold days.
